WHICH_PRECOMMITTED_BRANCH_APPLIES.ruled_out_large_early_margin_then_collap: DEFINITIVELY NOT THIS. No checkpoint shows a jointly positive margin of any material size. The largest single-axis mean is delta_A=+0.125 at 400k, whose 95% interval [-0.125,+0.375] contains zero, and at that same checkpoint delta_B is NEGATIVE (-0.083). There is no candidate hump to have collapsed from.
WHICH_PRECOMMITTED_BRANCH_APPLIES.why_this_rather_than_flat_near_zero_thro: These two branches are close, and the honest choice is the more conservative one. 'Flat near zero' would imply a stable near-zero margin; what we actually observe is SIGN-FLIPPING on both axes, with between-checkpoint swings (~0.25 on delta_A) comparable to the CI half-widths (~0.25). That is the signature of an underpowered scan, not of an established flat line. Selecting 'flat' would let us claim a shape the data does not support.
WHICH_PRECOMMITTED_BRANCH_APPLIES.consequence_of_that_choice: The precommitment for noisy_non_monotone says: 'report as underpowered and do not read a shape into it.' We therefore do NOT claim a trajectory shape, and we do NOT treat 'the fix is upstream in acquisition' as a CONCLUSION licensed by this experiment -- that inference belongs to the 'flat' branch, which we did not select.

WHAT_THIS_RESULT_DOES_ESTABLISH: No large transient specialization phase was detected anywhere in the 1M-step B3-3 4v4 run, at the resolution this scan was designed to provide (5 checkpoints, n=24 shared seeds).
The retention failure mode -- 'specialization was acquired and subsequently lost' -- has no support in this data. This is the branch the experiment was built to detect, and it did not fire.
WHAT_THIS_RESULT_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: That specialization never existed at any point in training. Absence of a DETECTABLE large transient at n=24 is not proof of absence of a small or short-lived one.

That acquisition is the failing stage. That is a plausible direction of attention, supported by OTHER evidence (the 6v6 Share-0 teacher result, the terminal B3-3 FAIL), but it is not a conclusion this underpowered scan licenses on its own.
Any reinterpretation of the sealed terminal FAIL (CONFIRMATORY_B3_3_4V4_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json), which stands unchanged.

DECISION_NOT_TO_INCREASE_N.decision: This scan will NOT be re-run at n=64 or n=128 to narrow the intervals.
DECISION_NOT_TO_INCREASE_N.rationale: Its purpose was to detect a LARGE transient hump. It did not find one. Determining whether some checkpoint's true margin is +0.06 rather than +0.02 would not change which intervention family we pursue, so the additional episodes would buy no decision-relevant information.
DECISION_NOT_TO_INCREASE_N.also_already_precommitted: The frozen spec's NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD list already forbids 'adding checkpoints or seeds after inspecting the trajectory'. This decision is consistent with that freeze rather than a new judgement made after seeing the numbers.

CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_INTERVENTION_SHORTLI.retention_family_DEPRIORITISED: Policy Consolidation (ICML 2019), Kickstarting, EMA/teacher retention, KL-constrained fine-tuning, early stopping on a specialization metric, and specialization-margin checkpointing all address 'learned it, then lost it'. That pattern is unsupported here, so this family drops off the near-term shortlist. See docs/LITERATURE_REVIEW_SPECIALIZATION_AT_SCALE.md section 5, whose candidacy was explicitly made conditional on this diagnostic.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_THE_INTERVENTION_SHORTLI.not_the_same_as_refuted: Deprioritised on absence of the pattern they fix, not refuted as techniques.
